subject: Young Adult Gambling Assessment
overview: The Board discussed potential regulations for synthetic hemp and Kratom, finalized vaccine clinic standing orders, and reviewed a needs assessment on gambling among local young adults.

items.title: Local Market Motion Wrap-Up
items.summary: The Board concluded a previous vote regarding the upcoming market season.

items.title: Synthetic Hemp and Kratom Regulation Discussion
items.summary: Director MaryAnn O'Connor detailed plans for a regional environmental scan and potential local regulations to restrict synthetic THC products and Kratom.

items.title: Vaccine Standing Orders
items.summary: The Board approved updated standing orders for upcoming city-administered seasonal flu and COVID-19 vaccine clinics.

items.title: Monthly Reportable Disease Updates
items.summary: The Board reviewed regional reportable disease data for July and August, noting a summer increase in enteric diseases.

items.title: Young Adult Gambling Assessment Presentation
items.summary: Catherine Dhingra presented preliminary survey data on gambling behaviors among Medford residents aged 18 to 24, highlighting correlations with financial debt and substance use.

items.title: Meeting Date Correction
items.summary: The Board corrected the date of its next scheduled meeting to October 21, 2025.
